senses.gloss:
Aitiśāyana
authority on Pūrvamīmāṁsā. ref. to by Jaimini in Pūrvamīmāṁsāsūtras, III. ii. 43; III. iv. 24; VI. i. 6.

Aitihāsikarāsasaṅgraha
Jain. See Stuticaturviṁśatikā, Āgamodaya Samiti Series 51, Intro. p.. 51 fn., 61 fn.

Aitihyatattvarāddhānta
nimbārka. in 12 sections called Sandhis. by Nimbārka. (col. ‘Nimbādityavinirmite’). AK. 285 (inc.). BORI. 703 of 1884-87. 285 of 1891-95. BORI. D. IX. i. 192. Hpr. IV. 46. Rep. Hpr. 1901-6, p. 17. Rgb. 703.

Aitihyahārdasaṃvedya
nimbārka. in five chs. Hpr. IV. 47.
